about_the_game:
Memoryleak - Demo
Dive into the Memoryleak demo, where cutting-edge gameplay meets Texas-inspired storytelling. This early look at the game introduces you to a surreal world rooted in the spirit of the Lone Star State, blending historical elements with an eerie, futuristic twist.

Navigate glitchy landscapes, unravel mind-bending mysteries, and experience the evolving narrative that ties together Texas roots with a modern, high-stakes journey. From subtle nods to iconic Texas culture to haunting environments built with Unreal Engine 5, this demo sets the stage for an unforgettable adventure.

Expect a raw, unpolished experience filled with quirks and bugs—this is a true demo, and your feedback is the key to shaping the final game. Saddle up and step into Memoryleak's world—Texas-style!
